standard_prerequisites.name: Gerbe criterion
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the gerbe condition to properties (2)(a) local essential surjectivity and (2)(b) local transitivity.

standard_prerequisites.name: Explicit 2-fibre product model
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets us assume X' = Y' x_Y X with explicit objects (U, y', x, alpha).

core_obligations: Fix the explicit fibre-product model for X'.
Property (2)(a): lift a covering trivializing y in Y through X, and pair the trivializing object with y'|_{U_i} to build objects of the fibre product over U_i mapping to y'|_{U_i}.

Property (2)(b): given x'_1, x'_2 over the same y' and b' between their Y'-components, trivialize F(x_1) -> F(x_2) locally through the gerbe condition on X -> Y; pair the local morphism a_i with b'|_{U_i} to build morphisms of the fibre product.
proof_roadmap: Work in the explicit fibre-product model and lift both gerbe properties of X -> Y through the base change Y' -> Y.
difficulty_reason: Two direct construction checks in the explicit model, each a base-changed pairing of already-available morphisms.
